usedFor: Awork holds time entries, and Google Sheets logs each one when “New Time Entry” runs “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Time Entry” in Awork, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every logged time entry becomes a sheet row you can total or share without opening Awork.

watchOut: “Add New Row to Sheet” maps columns by header or by letter, so check the mapping before entries flow in.
